name: Cofawer
dexEntry: It is said that this Pokémon was born from the blood of Mishanter. It's rumoured to only awaken when ground that has been touched with the blood of Mishanter is disturbed. Some say that it was once a normal Sawsbuck, but upon licking the blood of Mishanter off the grass it died on, a Yamask took residence inside its body. It however fused with the Yamask and became that of which it is today.
